about: Everything that moves in the workbench, for the motion review (#motion-review, src/motionreview.ts). A test checks that every mascot scene and every @keyframes rule of page.html is listed here, so a new animation can't ship without an entry.

scenes.name: Dozing
scenes.where: Check, with no code in the editor

scenes.name: All good
scenes.where: Check with nothing to fix, a Try it run that works, Test all when every combination works, a note beside the code

scenes.name: Oops
scenes.where: Try it when the handler can't load or the session ends, Test all with failures, error messages

scenes.name: Fixed
scenes.where: Not used in the workbench at the moment

scenes.name: Looking around
scenes.where: The first-run choice, the test guide, an info note beside the code, a stopped Test all, Nucli editing the code during a fix

scenes.name: Searching
scenes.where: The Hub list with no match, Fix with AI while it waits for the answer

scenes.name: Waiting
scenes.where: A Hub handler that takes over 300 ms to arrive, sending a report
scenes.says: Something without a known length is under way.

scenes.name: Progress ring
scenes.where: Test all, once a run has taken 300 ms
scenes.says: How far a run is. At the end the ring closes and turns green, a check pops and he smiles; red and a "!" when the run found failures.

scenes.name: Pushing the bar
scenes.where: Files, while a linked game folder is read
scenes.says: How far the read is. He stands ready while the files are listed, strains when it stalls and hops at the end.

ui.name: Dialogs and Settings
ui.moves: Fade in and rise 6 px; the backdrop fades in.

ui.name: Dialogs, the lively look
ui.moves: The same, with a spring and a longer rise.
ui.when: A dialog opens in a look with spring motion.

ui.name: Sheets on phones
ui.moves: Dialogs slide up from the bottom edge.
ui.when: A dialog opens on a narrow screen.

ui.name: Open
ui.moves: The palette drops in 8 px; its rows come in one after another.
ui.when: Open is shown; the rows only the first time.

ui.name: Messages
ui.moves: A toast or the notice drops in 10 px with a spring.

ui.name: Notes beside the code
ui.moves: The note pops in next to the line it's about.
ui.when: A fix, an insert or a setting reports where it acted.

ui.name: Fixed lines
ui.moves: A changed line glows green and fades.
ui.when: A quick fix, Fix all or an AI fix changes code.

ui.name: Tips
ui.moves: A tip that fits what you're doing slides into the tip bar; what it points at pulses three times.

ui.name: Test guide
ui.moves: The step you're sent to flashes once.
ui.when: A link jumps to a step of the beta test guide.

ui.name: Spinner
ui.when: Something waits and Duo and Nucli are turned off.

ui.name: AI buttons
ui.moves: A colour ribbon runs round the button.
ui.when: Hover or focus on a button that asks an AI.
